questions.prompt: Who was the unit of current named after?
questions.why: The unit of current, the ampere, is named after Andre-Marie Ampere.
questions.quote: The unit of current is named after the scientist Andre-Marie Ampere.

questions.prompt: For a current under 1 A, which knob should an ammeter use?
questions.why: The 1-A knob gives a more precise reading for currents under 1 A.
questions.quote: If the current is under 1 A, the 1-A knob should be connected to give a more precise reading.

questions.prompt: Why must an ammeter never be connected directly to the cell?
questions.why: A large current flowing through the ammeter can damage it.
questions.quote: Never connect the ammeter to the cell directly. Otherwise, a large current may flow through the ammeter and damage it.

questions.prompt: To what should an ammeter's black knob lead?
options: The positive terminal of the cell
The negative terminal of the cell
questions.why: The black knob leads to the negative terminal of the cell.
questions.quote: its black knob (–) to the negative terminal

questions.prompt: When more cells are added to a circuit, what happens to the bulb?
questions.why: More cells increase the current, so the bulb becomes brighter.
questions.quote: when more cells are added to the circuit, the current increases. The bulb also becomes brighter.

questions.prompt: What happens to the heating effect when the current increases?
questions.why: The heating effect becomes greater when the current increases.
questions.quote: This is the heating effect of current. This effect becomes greater when the current increases.

questions.prompt: What is the current produced by an electric eel large enough to do?
questions.why: The current from an electric eel is large enough to kill a human.
questions.quote: The current produced by an electric eel is large enough to kill a human.

questions.prompt: In the water flow model, what does the cell correspond to?
questions.why: The cell works like the water pump in the water flow model.
questions.quote: The cell works like the water pump and the bulb consumes energy like the turbine does.

questions.prompt: Which part of the water flow model consumes energy?
questions.why: The turbine consumes energy as it turns.
questions.quote: The turbine consumes energy as it turns.

questions.prompt: What does an electric motor convert electrical energy into?
questions.why: An electric motor converts electrical energy to kinetic energy.
questions.quote: An electric motor converts electrical energy to kinetic energy.
